summary: Six independent fresh-context read-only agent reviews across this branch; no CRITICAL or HIGH in any round. Rounds 1-4 covered the ExtractSubtitleVTT fingerprint-key invalidation (recorded separately at 8c46e76). Round 5 covered the merge resolving main's #496 (cacheIsFresh) and #498 (bounded exec waits) and confirmed structurally — AST diff with comments stripped, plus 15 mutants across BOTH test suites — that no work was lost from either side. Round 6 covered the combined diff at 6016192 and found one MEDIUM: the external .vtt sidecar NAME_MAX gap I had documented as 'not fixable here' was a one-liner, because what overruns is the DERIVED name ShiftVTTCues creates in cacheDir, not the sidecar's own name which is only read; cacheStem now applies at that consumer, which also covers any future producer. Same round produced the ETag (Last-Modified is insufficient once the key is a fingerprint, because the served file can move backwards in time on an rsync -a restore) and 'private' (the URL is on the query-token promotion allowlist). Round 7 reviewed c0a3c0d CLEAN with four LOW/NIT, two of which were tests passing for the wrong reason: a 224-char fixture too short to exercise the converter bounds at all, and an ETag test that pinned only the header's presence. Both strengthened and the named surviving mutants now die. DISCLOSURE: the delta after that final CLEAN verdict is test-strengthening plus comments only — production code is AST-identical to the reviewed commit c0a3c0d with comments stripped (verified), and the strengthened tests were checked against the exact mutants the reviewer named. No further independent round was run over that delta. Verification: go build, go vet, gofmt clean; go test ./... 25 packages pass, race-clean at -count=5; sole failure TestCreateSession_VideoCodecOutClamp needs ffmpeg and fails identically on main. Residual gaps documented in code and handoff: concurrent same-key extraction unguarded (pre-existing); the stat-failure fallback still reaches the old bug in both directions; ConvertSubtitleToVTT's mutant unverifiable without ffmpeg.
